QUOTE: The schema and code axes are never auto-refreshed, because a build from a stale server process would re-stamp the index with old pipeline logic and could drop layers. The auto-refresh path never attempts that build.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says auto-refresh skips the schema and code axes, but it never says the write path refuses (rather than warns), nor that the refusal sits ahead of the build decision so a force flag can't override it. It even suggests force-refresh for the older-index schema case.
